correctness.rationale: For F(W)=||W||_F^2/2, the gradient equals W. With strict descending positive diagonal and rank r dividing m, the exact top-r left projector at t=kT is the next contiguous r-block. Unit projected-SGD annihilates those entries in one step, leaving remaining nonzero rows orthogonal to the held projector. Therefore each nonterminal block has precisely T-1 zero compact-gradient updates even while full gradient is nonzero, and the first zero matrix is W_{(m/r-1)T+1}. Inductive proof covers every K>=2, T>=2, rank r; test cases m/r=2,3,4 show exact blind indices and termination. No stochastic or Adam conclusion follows.
